name: logo-cloud-marquee
title: Logo cloud: Scrolling marquee
description: Wordmarks that scroll sideways forever with faded edges. They pause under the pointer and stand still in a tidy grid on keyboard focus or for people who turn motion off.
author: DressCode UI <https://dresscodeui.com>
docs:
The block is in components/dresscode/logo-cloud-marquee.tsx; render it in any page.
It wears your DressCode theme (its colors, fonts and corners, and the dc-* classes the theme adds). Pick one at https://dresscodeui.com/themes, e.g. npx shadcn@latest add https://dresscodeui.com/r/dresscode/mono.json
